crossRefs.note: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and…
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…
Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened…
The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
Saul was very angry, and this saying displeased him. He said, “They have creditd David with ten thousands, and they…
When Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he stood in awe of him.
But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.
Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all…
Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to…
Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men…

translations.web: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
translations.bsb: A crucible for silver and a furnace for gold, but a man is tested by the praise accorded him.
translations.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
translations.asv: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold; And a man is tried by his praise.
